# uyuni_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    uyuni = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/svalabs/uyuni"
    }
  }
}

provider "uyuni" {
  host     = "192.168.1.100"
  username = "admin"
  password = "admin"
}

resource "uyuni_user" "sgiertz" {
  login     = "sgiertz"
  firstname = "Simone"
  lastname  = "Giertz"
  email     = "sgiertz@foo.bar"
  password  = "test123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `firstname` (String)
- `lastname` (String)
- `login` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
